episodes.title: Torrejas de Natas
episodes.summary: After years apart, childhood sweethearts Tita and Pedro are reunited – but a deeply rooted family tradition rocks their plan to marry.

episodes.title: Pastel Chabela
episodes.summary: While a heartbroken Tita endures her sister's wedding preparations, Pedro is caught between his father and his friend.

episodes.title: Codornices en Pétalos de Rosa
episodes.summary: As the rebels continue their rise, Tita and Pedro attempt to steal moments together under Rosaura's watchful eye.

episodes.title: Atole
episodes.summary: After learning the extent of Rosaura's betrayal, Tita's fury is put on hold when she's forced to help her sister through a medical crisis.

episodes.title: Guajolote en Mole
episodes.summary: As Rosaura struggles to bond with Roberto, Elena limits Tita's access to him. Meanwhile, Pedro makes a drastic decision for his freedom.

episodes.title: Chorizo Norteño
episodes.summary: As devastating news from Rosaura reaches the family, Tita finally rebels against her mother, while Pedro throws himself into battle.

episodes.title: Alegrías de Amaranto
episodes.summary: As a distraught Tita is slowly brought back to life under the care of Dr. Brown, Pedro sets out to find his beloved.

episodes.title: Caldo de Colita de Res
episodes.summary: As life begins anew for Tita, Pedro struggles to find meaning. Mama Elena's condition worsens, while Gertrudis wages a private battle.

episodes.title: Champandongo
episodes.summary: As the sisters mourn Mama Elena, Pedro lands in his uncle's crosshairs, and Rosaura sets out to reestablish herself and Las Palomas.

episodes.title: Pan de Muerto
episodes.summary: As Rosaura attempts to speed up the wedding, Tita is haunted by her mother, and Pedro learns disturbing truths about his uncle.

episodes.title: Frijoles Gordos a la Tezcucana
episodes.summary: While Tita agonizes over whether to lie or tell the truth about her pregnancy, Pedro exposes his uncle's wrongdoings to General Vargas.

episodes.title: Chiles en Nogada
episodes.summary: As the day of her wedding arrives, Tita must decide once and for all whether her heart belongs to John or Pedro.
